present_convention: present is the observational cut O_t; no finite-width or infinitesimal present interval is modeled

axes.HISTORY: retrospective history to the left of the cut
axes.LATENT_PRESENT: response structure inside O_t^{-1}(y), transverse to the cut
axes.FUTURE: prospective/counterfactual response responsibility to the right of the cut

three_way_family.limit: three-way fraction of joint debt -> 1 as m -> infinity

claim_boundary: The result is finite and conditional on declared closures on a common carrier.
History, latent present, and future are not claimed to exhaust all ecological state responsibilities.
The result is interaction/coupling, not statistical confounding.
No continuous-time, infinitesimal-germ, stochastic, or infinite-state theorem is claimed.
